description:
We are a passionate team interested in space technology, Earth observation, environmental protection, and climate change. Our skills include Python, web development, AI, and data analysis. We aim to use NASA datasets and satellite imagery to develop innovative solutions to real-world problems.

We welcome creative and motivated teammates with skills in machine learning, GIS, remote sensing, data science, UI/UX, and research. You don't need to be an expert enthusiasm, teamwork.
